title: Whether you want Star Trek: Strange New Worlds or the pure nostalgia of The Original Series, this limited-time $2.99 Paramount+ streaming deal gets you both
summary: Paramount+ memberships are now only $2.99 per month for the first two months for Black Friday 2026. This gets you access to almost every season of Star Trek and a host of great movies. The offer ends Nov. 30.
contentText:
This year marked the 60th anniversary of the broadcast of the first-ever Star Trek episode, 'The Man Trap'. Since 1966, the franchise has grown and expanded into new seasons with a huge cast of actors, with 'Strange New Worlds' releasing its season four finale at the end of September. From the classic era seasons, all the way through Discovery and Picard to the latest additions, Paramount+ gives you access to them all.

Get any Paramount+ subscription for only $2.99/month for two months and watch almost every episode of Star Trek!

$2.99 for 2 Months: was $13.99 now $2.99
Pay just $2.99 a month for the first two months for Paramount+ Essential ($6 off, ad-supported) and Premium ($11 off, ad-free).

Paramount+ is the place to be if you're a Trekkie, with 12 original series and 14 movies.

Offer ends Nov. 30.

Note: After two months, the price rises to $8.99 for Essential plans and $13.99 for Premium plans but you can cancel anytime. View Deal

With the exception of Prodigy, you can watch the back catalog of Star Trek shows on Paramount+. Paramount Paramount Paramount+ CBS Photo Archive/Getty Paramount 2026 has seen the Star Trek Franchise grow into new territory with the premiere of Starfleet Academy and the more recent season four of Strange New Worlds, whether you are a fan of the genre-hopping or not.

Regardless of your opinion on the new episodes, this year has had a lot of people looking back at the entire franchise as a whole, with many wanting to do a deep dive and rewatch of The Original Series, Discovery and Enterprise.

Key features: Nearly every single Star Trek show and movie, including the new Starfleet Academy Show, ready to stream. Paramount Plus also boasts a huge catalog of other shows and films, viewable on a wide variety of devices.

Price history: We've seen Paramount Plus offer a range of deals in the past, but you sometimes have to lock in for a year. $2.99 a month for ad-free Paramount Plus Premium is a real steal (and the ad-supported tier is a good deal too), saving $6 a month and $11 a month for the first two months, respectively.

Consensus: If you're a Trekkie, Paramount Plus is an absolute must-have. From movies to shows, live-action and animated, you'll find hours and hours of Star Trek content on the service. Whether it's old or new Trek you crave, you're absolutely spoilt for choice. There's a wealth of non-sci-fi content too, from 1883 to Tulsa King.
